properties.name: Cut v0.65.0
properties.rationale: Anthony 2026-09-19: 'Please cut v0.65.0'. Eleven PRs since v0.64.0; minor by the changelog's own bucket rule — two new tools (replace_text, find_skills), a new CLI verb (--call), new constructor parameters and id aliases.
properties.summary: Version moved to 0.65.0 in Cargo.toml, reflow2.toml and Cargo.lock, and in the two AGENTS.md claims; CHANGELOG section closed; docs/upgrading-to-v0.65.0.md written and linked from the overview, owed because the schema stamp moved (ChangeEvent.change_type gained `decision_settled`).
